newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-MCMILLAN KEEPS INDIA IN CHECK.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MCMILLAN KEEPS INDIA IN CHECK.

text.p: Brian McMillan kept India at bay as the tourists took the early honours against South Africa on the second day of the second test on Friday.
McMillan reached 50 not out as South Africa crawled to 339 for six in their first innings at lunch after India broke through twice in the first 10 overs.

Resuming on 280 for four, South African skipper Hansie Cronje had added only one to his overnight 40 before presenting a catch off Javagal Srinath to wicket keeper Nayan Mongia. It was Mongia's fourth catch of the innings and his 50th test dismissal.
Six overs later, all-rounder Shaun Pollock, on one, edged Venkatesh Prasad to Sachin Tendulkar at first slip.
Dave Richardson with 12 in 76 minutes kept McMillan company to the interval as South Africa scored just 59 runs in the session.
